name: Eikyuu Koutei Shoujo ~Shima no Mahoutsukai Hen~
original_name: 永久皇帝少女 ～島の魔法使い編～
source:
Main character hears mysterious words from the teacher upon leaving the hospital: “Be careful of traffic accidents”. After a certain incident he gets acquainted with Nene, a magical girl who hates using magic. He gets interested in this girl and soon becomes involved into "emperor's legacy".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
出院时，主人公听到老师说了一句神秘的话，“小心交通事故”。某次事件后，他结识了讨厌使用魔法的魔法少女宁宁。他对这名少女产生了兴趣，不久便卷入了围绕“皇帝遗产”的事件。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
